title: Practitioner Insights on Fairness Requirements in the AI Development Life Cycle: An Interview Study

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of practitioner interviews discussing strategies like data balancing, removing gender as a feature, and evaluating demographic skew using model cards.
Qualitative analysis of practitioner interviews detailing dataset representation challenges, skin tone recognition errors, and bias mitigation for specific racial and ethnic groups.
Qualitative analysis of practitioner interviews describing counterfactual testing in chatbots by comparing outputs for queries involving different religions (e.g., Christian vs. Muslim).
Qualitative analysis of practitioner interviews addressing challenges in modeling extreme income levels and handling financial status distributions to ensure fairness.
Qualitative analysis of practitioner interviews highlighting missing data from certain regions and the removal of location-based attributes (e.g., city) to prevent biased outcomes.
Qualitative analysis of practitioner interviews reporting the use of model cards and metrics to evaluate demographic skew broken down by age.
